secrets.name: INCEPTION_API_KEY
secrets.description: Inception Labs API key used by the Mercury-2 article rewrite/extraction paths. Get it from https://platform.inceptionlabs.ai (API keys).

secrets.name: BANKONE_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of the Bankone source connector service used to hydrate the vehicle catalog.

secrets.name: BANKTWO_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of the Banktwo source connector service used to hydrate the vehicle catalog.

secrets.name: AUTODATA_BANKONE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bearer token for the Bankone source connector. Both connectors answer /healthz without auth but return 401 on /v1/catalog/* until a token is supplied.

secrets.name: AUTODATA_BANKTWO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bearer token for the Banktwo source connector. Both connectors answer /healthz without auth but return 401 on /v1/catalog/* until a token is supplied.
